name: mcp-catalogue
description: A price list and rate card the quotes and invoice servers read by SKU.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: sku_set
tools.description: Add a catalogue line or reprice one: a code, a name, a unit, an optional VAT rate, and a price in minor units for one currency, tier and valid-from date. Free tier: 25 SKUs.

tools.name: sku_get
tools.description: Show the price of one SKU as of a date, in one currency and tier: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names the row and any later one already booked. Free.

tools.name: sku_list
tools.description: List catalogue lines with the price in force today, filtered by code prefix, by currency and by tier. A SKU with no price in that currency and tier is listed and said to have none. Free.

tools.name: sku_delete
tools.description: Delete a catalogue line raised by mistake. Only one that no rate card points at and that has never priced a resolved line can go; the refusal names what depends on it. Free on every tier.

tools.name: rate_set
tools.description: Set the hourly rate on a labour rate card: a role, a currency, an hourly rate in minor units and the day it comes into force. An update replaces the row for that currency and date. Free.

tools.name: rate_get
tools.description: Show the hourly rate for a role as of a date and currency: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names it. With no role given, lists every card. Free.

tools.name: lines_resolve
tools.description: Turn a list of sku or role lines into invoice_create-ready and quote_create-ready items priced from the catalogue as of each line's date. An unknown code is refused by name and never priced. Free.

tools.name: price_list_text
tools.description: Print the price list as plain text: every SKU with the price in force on a date, per currency and tier, with the valid-from date and any later price already booked, then the labour rates. Free.

tools.name: price_list_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to write the A4 price list for one currency and tier and return the file path: every SKU with its unit, its price in force and the day that price started. Pro.

tools.name: catalogue_report
tools.description: Report the catalogue: how many SKUs there are, how many price rows are in force today, which rows a later row already replaces, and which SKUs carry no price in the profile's default currency. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
